dictionary.lore: An ancient fossil mined from a part of the Bricio Volcano in the eastern part of north Elgaia. It currently has no use other than being sold as a travel souvenir. However, in recent years rumors of a new refining method for it have spread, though the specifics of this method have been kept secret.
